questions.q: Piky, Quiky and Riky alone finish an assignment in 7, 8 and 11 days. Together they earn 1,105 coins. Find each share.
Numbers: 325 618 378 461 782 562 213. If the 1st and 3rd digits of each are interchanged, what is the sum of the product of the 1st and 3rd digits of the lowest number and that of the highest number?
questions.why: New numbers: 523 816 873 164 287 265 312. Lowest 164 → 1 × 4 = 4; highest 873 → 8 × 3 = 24; total 28. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

questions.q: Find the wrong number in the series: 49, 60, 82, 115, 159, 217, 280
questions.why: In the correct series the differences increase by 11 each time, so 217 should be 214. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A ₹20,00,000 portfolio loses 20% a year, compounded. At the end of year 2, after that year's loss, ₹25,000 is added. What is the value right after the injection?

An investor splits money between Stock A (8% dividend) and Stock B (12% dividend), total face value ₹15,000. If the amounts are switched, annual income rises by ₹120. What was the original annual income?
questions.why: Income = 1800 − 0.04x; switched = 1200 + 0.04x. Difference 120 gives x = 9000, so 1800 − 360 = 1440. GPSC JSO pre-screening, Jun 2026.

questions.q: If 20 July 2019 was a Saturday, what day of the week was 26 June 2020?
questions.why: 342 days later; 342 mod 7 = 6, so count 6 days on from Saturday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Sita is the brother of Rekha. Kiran is the father of Sita. Kavita is the brother of Deepak. Deepak is the daughter of Rekha. Who is the uncle of Kavita?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Sita. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present worth of a sum is ₹576 and the banker's gain is ₹16. What is the true discount?
questions.why: TD² = PW × BG = 576 × 16 = 9216, so TD = 96. GPSC CBRT, Dec 2023.

questions.q: Statements: All rivers are lakes. All lakes are ponds. Conclusions: I. All ponds are rivers. II. Some rivers are ponds.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present ages of Anil and Rekha are in the ratio 6 : 2. After 2 years the ratio will be 8 : 3. What is Rekha's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 6k and 2k: (6k + 2)/(2k + 2) = 8/3 gives k = 5, so Rekha is 10. GPSC-style practice item.
